title: Finiteness of the symmetric-product morphism
statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme, $n\ge1$, $X=(\mathbf P^1_S)^n$ the $n$-fold fibre product of $\mathbf P^1_S=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};S)$ over $S$ [def-pc-fibre-product] with projections $\mathrm{pr}_i$ and $p_n:X\to S$, and $\mathbf P^n_S=\mathbf P(\{0,\dots,n\};S)$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] with homogeneous coordinates $T_0,\dots,T_n$. Let $x_i=\mathrm{pr}_i^*T_0$, $y_i=\mathrm{pr}_i^*T_1$, let $F_0,\dots,F_n$ be the polynomials of [def-weil-pbc-symmetric-product-morphism], $\prod_{i=1}^n(x_it+y_i)=\sum_{j=0}^nF_jt^j$, viewed as global sections of $\mathcal L_n=\bigotimes_i\mathrm{pr}_i^*\mathcal O(1)$, and let

$$
 \sigma_n:X\longrightarrow\mathbf P^n_S,\qquad ((x_1:y_1),\dots,(x_n:y_n))\longmapsto[F_0:\cdots:F_n],
$$

be the symmetric-product morphism constructed in [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-product-properties] (the morphism $\varphi_{p_n,(\mathcal L_n,(F_0,\dots,F_n))}$ of [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections]). Then $\sigma_n$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism].

Moreover, for an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq S$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the preimage under $\sigma_n$ of the chart $D_+(T_0)$ over $\operatorname{Spec}R$, which is $\operatorname{Spec}R[u_1,\dots,u_n]$ with $u_l=T_l/T_0$, is the chart of $X$ over $\operatorname{Spec}R$ where all $y_i$ are invertible, $\operatorname{Spec}R[z_1,\dots,z_n]$ with $z_i=x_i/y_i$; the ring map sends $u_l$ to the elementary symmetric polynomial $e_l(z_1,\dots,z_n)$ and is finite, each $z_i$ being a root of

$$
 T^n-e_1T^{n-1}+\cdots+(-1)^ne_n.
$$

Likewise the preimage of $D_+(T_n)$ is the chart where all $x_i$ are invertible, $\operatorname{Spec}R[w_1,\dots,w_n]$ with $w_i=y_i/x_i$, with $T_l/T_n\mapsto e_{n-l}(w)$, a finite ring map.

proof.text: *The target charts.* Let $\sigma_n=\varphi_{p_n,(\mathcal L_n,(F_j))}$ as constructed in [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-product-properties] from [def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections] (the node [def-weil-pbc-symmetric-product-morphism] only gives the $F_j$ and the formula). For an affine open $S'=\operatorname{Spec}R\subseteq S$ and $j\in\{0,\dots,n\}$ put $V_{j,S'}=D_+(T_j)_S\cap q_n^{-1}(S')$, where $D_+(T_j)_S=\mathrm{pr}_2^{-1}(D_+(T_j))$ and $q_n=\mathrm{pr}_1:\mathbf P^n_S\to S$. Since $\mathbf P^n_S=S\times_{\operatorname{Spec}\mathbf Z}\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change] and $D_+(T_j)\cong\mathbf A^n_{\mathbf Z}$ (renumber the coordinates so that $T_j$ becomes $T_0$ in [lemma-nagata-relative-affine-space-open-immersion]), $V_{j,S'}\cong\mathbf A^n_{S'}=\operatorname{Spec}R[u_{l/j}:l\neq j]$ is affine, $u_{l/j}$ being the pullback of $T_l/T_j$. The $D_+(T_j)$ cover $\mathbf P^n_{\mathbf Z}$ and the $S'$ cover $S$, so the $V_{j,S'}$ form an affine open cover of $\mathbf P^n_S$.

source.place: Section (Tag 01ND), Definition 01NF: P^n_S is the base change of P^n_Z, covered by the D_+(T_j)

proof.text:
*Their preimages.* By [lem-weil-pbc-projective-morphism-chart-preimage] (i), $\sigma_n^{-1}(D_+(T_j)_S)=X_{F_j}$, the open set where the section $F_j$ of $\mathcal L_n$ does not vanish, and by (ii) $\sigma_n^*(u_{l/j})=F_l/F_j$ there. Since $q_n\circ\sigma_n=p_n$ [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-product-over-base], $\sigma_n^{-1}(q_n^{-1}(S'))=p_n^{-1}(S')$. Hence
$$
\sigma_n^{-1}(V_{j,S'})=W_{j,S'}:=X_{F_j}\cap p_n^{-1}(S').
$$
These are the opens the affine-local criteria of steps 5 and 8 need: preimages of the members of an affine open cover of the target. They are not in general among the charts $U_A$ of [lem-weil-pbc-p1-power-affine-charts] (see step 4).

*Expansion of $F_j$.* For $A\subseteq\{1,\dots,n\}$ let $M_A=\prod_{i\in A}y_i\prod_{i\notin A}x_i\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L_n)$. Multiplying out $\prod_i(x_it+y_i)$, the coefficient of $t^j$ is the sum over the ways of choosing $x_i$ from exactly $j$ factors and $y_i$ from the others, so $F_j=\sum_{|A|=n-j}M_A$; in particular $F_0=M_{\{1,\dots,n\}}=\prod_iy_i$ and $F_n=M_\emptyset=\prod_ix_i$. The fibre of $\mathcal L_n$ at a point is the tensor product of the one-dimensional fibres of the $\mathrm{pr}_i^*\mathcal O(1)$, so a product of sections is nonzero there iff each factor is: $X_{M_A}=\bigcap_{i\in A}X_{y_i}\cap\bigcap_{i\notin A}X_{x_i}=U_A$, the chart of [lem-weil-pbc-p1-power-affine-charts].

source.place: ## Proof (and the unit sk-thm-reduction, step 5); Stacks 0A4F asserts finiteness without proof

proof.text: *$W=W_{j,S'}$ is affine.* On $W$ the section $F_j$ trivializes $\mathcal L_n$, so $s_A=M_A/F_j\in\Gamma(W,\mathcal O)$ (the function with $M_A=s_AF_j$) is defined, and by step 3, $\sum_{|A|=n-j}s_A=1$: the $s_A$ with $|A|=n-j$ generate the unit ideal of $\Gamma(W,\mathcal O)$. For each such $A$, $W_{s_A}=W\cap X_{M_A}=U\cap X_{F_j}$ with $U=U_A\cap p_n^{-1}(S')$, which is affine by [lem-weil-pbc-p1-power-affine-charts] (ii). On $U$ the section $M_A$ trivializes $\mathcal L_n$, so $g_A=F_j/M_A\in\Gamma(U,\mathcal O)$ and $U\cap X_{F_j}=U_{g_A}$ is a principal open of the affine scheme $U\cong\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(U,\mathcal O)$, namely $\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(U,\mathcal O)_{g_A}$, hence affine. By [lem-weil-pbc-affine-unit-ideal-basic-opens], $W$ is affine. (For $j=0$ the only $A$ is $\{1,\dots,n\}$ and $W_{0,S'}=U_{\{1,\dots,n\}}\cap p_n^{-1}(S')$, the chart where all $y_i$ are invertible; for $j=n$, $W_{n,S'}=U_\emptyset\cap p_n^{-1}(S')$. For $0<j<n$, $W_{j,S'}$ is $S_n$-stable and is not contained in any one $U_A$: for $n=2$, $j=1$, both $((1:0),(0:1))\in U_{\{2\}}$ and $((0:1),(1:0))\in U_{\{1\}}$ lie in $W_{1}$ ($F_1=x_1y_2+x_2y_1=1$ at both), and neither lies in the other chart nor in $U_\emptyset$, $U_{\{1,2\}}$. So the $2^n$ charts $U_A$ cover $X$ but are not preimages of target opens, and the affine-local criterion cannot be applied to them; this is why the cover by the $W_{j,S'}$ is used.)

*$\sigma_n$ is affine.* By steps 1, 2 and 4, $\mathbf P^n_S$ has the affine open cover $\{V_{j,S'}\}$ whose preimages $W_{j,S'}$ are affine; hence $\sigma_n$ is affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism] by [pqf-lem-affine-local-target].

*$\sigma_n$ is proper.* $p_n$ is proper: by induction, $p_1=q_1$ is proper [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper]; for $m\ge2$ the projection $\mathrm{pr}_1:(\mathbf P^1_S)^{m-1}\times_S\mathbf P^1_S\to(\mathbf P^1_S)^{m-1}$ is the base change of $q_1$ along $p_{m-1}$, hence proper [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change], and $p_m=p_{m-1}\circ\mathrm{pr}_1$ is proper [lem-weil-pbc-proper-composition]. $q_n$ is proper [lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper], in particular separated [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Since $q_n\circ\sigma_n=p_n$ [lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-product-over-base], $\sigma_n$ is proper by [lem-weil-pbc-proper-over-separated]; so it is universally closed and of finite type, in particular locally of finite type.
*$\sigma_n$ is integral.* It is affine (step 5) and universally closed (step 6), hence integral by [pqf-lem-integral-univclosed].

*$\sigma_n$ is finite.* It is integral (step 7) and locally of finite type (step 6), hence finite by [pqf-lem-integral-lft-finite]: it is affine and, for every affine open $V\subseteq\mathbf P^n_S$, $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(\sigma_n^{-1}V,\mathcal O)$ is finite, which is finiteness in the sense of [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism].

*The charts over $D_+(T_0)$ and $D_+(T_n)$ (the 'moreover').* Let $S'=\operatorname{Spec}R$. By step 4, $\sigma_n^{-1}(V_{0,S'})=W_{0,S'}=U_{\{1,\dots,n\}}\cap p_n^{-1}(S')$, which is $\operatorname{Spec}R[z_1,\dots,z_n]$, $z_i=x_i/y_i$, by [lem-weil-pbc-p1-power-affine-charts] (ii), and $V_{0,S'}=\operatorname{Spec}R[u_1,\dots,u_n]$, $u_l=u_{l/0}$ (step 1). By step 2 the ring map sends $u_l$ to $F_l/F_0$; dividing $\prod_i(x_it+y_i)=\sum_lF_lt^l$ by $F_0=\prod_iy_i$ gives $\prod_i(z_it+1)=\sum_le_l(z)t^l$, so $u_l\mapsto e_l(z)$. Each $z_i$ is a root of $\prod_k(T-z_k)=T^n-e_1T^{n-1}+\cdots+(-1)^ne_n$, a monic polynomial with coefficients in the image, so $z_i$ is integral; the $z_i$ generate $R[z_1,\dots,z_n]$, so the ring map is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-finite-of-integral-generators]. With $x_i$ and $y_i$ interchanged: $W_{n,S'}=U_\emptyset\cap p_n^{-1}(S')=\operatorname{Spec}R[w_1,\dots,w_n]$, $w_i=y_i/x_i$; dividing by $F_n=\prod_ix_i$ gives $\prod_i(t+w_i)=\sum_le_{n-l}(w)t^l$, so $T_l/T_n\mapsto e_{n-l}(w)$, and each $w_i$ is a root of $\prod_k(T-w_k)$, so this ring map is finite too. (This is the computation of the blueprint and of the unit's step 5. It does not prove finiteness on its own: for $n\ge2$, $V_0$ and $V_n$ do not cover $\mathbf P^n_S$, e.g. $\sigma_2((1:0),(0:1))=[0:1:0]$; steps 1-8 cover all charts.)

split_report.summary: Read Stacks 0A4F (finiteness of sigma_n is asserted without proof), the blueprint node, the unit sk-thm-reduction step 5, and the nodes defining sigma_n. sigma_n is constructed in lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-product-properties as phi_{p_n,(L_n,(F_j))} of def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections; def-weil-pbc-symmetric-product-morphism only gives the F_j; the statement now cites both and introduces its objects. The imported proof was incomplete: the charts where all y_i or all x_i are invertible are the preimages of D_+(T_0), D_+(T_n), but for n >= 2 these two target charts do not cover P^n (sigma_2((1:0),(0:1)) = [0:1:0]), and the mixed charts U_A ('y_i != 0 for i in A, x_i != 0 otherwise') cover (P^1)^n but are not preimages of target opens (step 4 gives the example), so the affine-local criterion does not apply to them. New proof: preimage of D_+(T_j) over an affine Spec R of S is W = {F_j != 0}; it is affine by Stacks 01QF, using F_j = sum over |A| = n-j of M_A so that the M_A/F_j generate the unit ideal and W ∩ U_A is a principal open of the affine chart U_A; so sigma_n is affine (01S8); it is proper as a morphism over S from the proper (P^1_S)^n to the separated P^n_S (01W6); affine + universally closed gives integral (01WM), and integral + locally of finite type gives finite (01WJ). The chart computation of the blueprint (z_i roots of T^n - e_1 T^{n-1} + ... , finite by 02JJ) is kept as the 'moreover' part and step 9. 'finite' now points to def-weil-finite-integral-morphism instead of def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions. Five new nodes: two unsplit (chart preimage under a morphism given by sections; the affine charts of (P^1_S)^n), three Mathlib leaves (01QF, 01W6, 02JJ).

reviewed.note: the chart argument of the imported node and of the parenthetical in unit step 5 does not prove finiteness for n >= 2 (the two charts D_+(T_0), D_+(T_n) do not cover P^n, and the mixed charts are not preimages of opens): finiteness proved instead by affine (01QF/01S8) + proper over separated (01W6) => integral (01WM) => finite (01WJ); the unit claim (sigma_n finite surjective) and the route are unchanged, so this is a node-level proof, not a route departure; pqf-lem-affine-local-target (sk-prop-nagata-sketch-zmt), lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change and lem-weil-pbc-proper-composition (sk-thm-br) accepted as tool uses; 5 new nodes, 3 Mathlib leaves
